title: Demand forecasts versus a standing order for platelet ordering: a simulation study of public data from two hospitals, with a retrospectively registered analysis plan
description: Code, result files and manuscript (draft v11) for an educational, advisory-only simulation study comparing demand forecasts with a standing order for platelet ordering. It uses only public aggregate data: daily platelet counts from University Hospital Aachen, 2008-2018 (Schilling et al., JMIR Med Inform 2022, CC BY 4.0) and the Stanford pip example data (GPL-2 or later). The analysis plan was registered retrospectively on OSF Registries on 14 November 2026, after the analyses were run (doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/PHQ42). Not a clinical tool and not ordering advice.
